# ============================================================================
# TRANSITIVE PINS (Python 3.10–3.11 + mitmproxy 11)
# ============================================================================
# mitmproxy 11.x requires h11<=0.14 and Flask<=3.1.0; httpcore 1.0.9+ (httpx →
# fastmcp) requires h11>=0.16 — unsatisfiable together. Pin httpcore 1.0.8 so
# h11 0.14.x works for both and pip avoids resolution-too-deep.
# mitmproxy 11 on Python 3.10 also caps typing-extensions<=4.11.0.
httpcore==1.0.8; python_version>="3.10" and python_version<"3.12"
h11>=0.13,<0.15; python_version>="3.10" and python_version<"3.12"
typing-extensions>=4.3.0,<=4.11.0; python_version>="3.10" and python_version<"3.11"
PySocks>=1.7.0,<2

# ============================================================================
# CORE FRAMEWORK DEPENDENCIES (ACTUALLY USED)
# ============================================================================
flask>=3.0.0,<=3.1.0,<4.0.0     # Web API; mitmproxy 11 needs <=3.1.0; 3.1.0 is also <=3.1.2 for mitmproxy 12
requests>=2.31.0,<3.0.0         # HTTP library (requests import)
psutil>=5.9.0,<6.0.0            # System utilities (psutil import)
fastmcp[tasks]>=3.1.0    	# MCP framework with background task support (Docket backend)
beautifulsoup4>=4.12.0,<5.0.0   # HTML parsing (from bs4 import BeautifulSoup)
selenium>=4.15.0,<5.0.0         # Browser automation (selenium imports)
webdriver-manager>=4.0.0,<5.0.0 # ChromeDriver management (referenced in code)
aiohttp>=3.8.0,<4.0.0           # Async HTTP (aiohttp import)
mitmproxy>=12.2.0,<13.0.0; python_version>="3.12"
mitmproxy==11.0.2; python_version>="3.10" and python_version<"3.12"
PyMySQL>=1.1.2,<2.0.0      # MySQL database connector (conditionally used for database interactions)
redis>=5.0.0,<6.0.0             # Optional: live tool logs via Redis Streams
